query: 召回程序及披露 召回程序及披露 衡量企业对潜在缺陷或安全风险产品执行召回的制度完备性与信息公开透明度。重点考察召回触发阈值、风险分级管理、消费者通知渠道及回收实物的闭环追踪能力。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备量化的召回触发指标；实行风险分级制度（如：严重、一般、轻微）；建立了多渠道主动通知机制（官网、短信、媒体）；并披露了详细的召回物资处置与效果评估流程。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的召回管理制度，具备基础的召回审批和执行流程，符合监管要求的被动披露程序，但缺乏主动监控触发机制或详细的风险分级说明。 • 0分（不合格）：无正式召回制度披露，或仅笼统提及“依法执行召回”。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：召回管理制度覆盖 >80% 的产品品类及所有销售区域（含海外市场），且定期进行模拟召回演练。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对强监管产品（如汽车、药品）执行，或未披露制度的适用范围比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 产品召回程序 召回制度 召回触发 风险分级 消费者通知 追溯 模拟召回 召回演练 召回效果评估 product recall procedure recall policy recall trigger risk classification consumer notification traceability mock recall simulated recall recall effectiveness 是否有正式召回管理制度及量化触发阈值？ 是否实行严重/一般/轻微等风险分级？ 消费者通知渠道有哪些？ 召回物资如何追踪与处置并评估效果？ 制度覆盖哪些品类与销售区域，是否有模拟召回演练？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '召回程序及披露'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有正式召回管理制度及量化触发阈值？ 是否实行严重/一般/轻微等风险分级？ 消费者通知渠道有哪些？ 召回物资如何追踪与处置并评估效果？ 制度覆盖哪些品类与销售区域，是否有模拟召回演练？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“依法召回”表述；仅有召回率数字；仅有产品安全政策总述而无召回细则；仅有监管处罚新闻无企业程序；区分：召回程序及披露关注制度触发分级通知与闭环追踪；产品安全政策是更广的全生命周期机制；产品回收率是结果统计指标。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: Every year, we evaluate the performance of our existing suppliers according to the criteria and procedures specified in the Regulations Governing Integrated Supplier Evaluation to ensure suppliers are aligned with our requirements. The Group's Technical Support Department works closely together with relevant departments to identify suitable suppliers and to assess their qualifications and performance. results.section: Approach to Sustainability / 3.1.3. Ensuring Operations in Compliance
results.text: Significant ESG risks | Potential Impacts | Response Approaches The Group will also assess the supplier's performance in a number of ESG areas, such as product and service quality, ethical conduct and environmental protection. Sun Ferry has set out its ESG requirements for suppliers in the Supplier Code and favours suppliers who demonstrate a commitment to the principles outlined in the Code in the supplier selection process. To verify that our suppliers meet our requirements and drive improvements, we assess the performance of our existing key suppliers annually against the criteria and procedures specified in the Comprehensive Supplier Evaluation Management Scheme. If suppliers fail to meet our requirements, they are required to develop corrective action plans and take corrective action.

results.text: The operation of cargo terminals is vulnerable to severe weather events as they are located close to the coastal areas. The Group pays attention to its terminal operators and cargo safety under unexpected extreme weather caused by climate change. To enhance the preparedness in responding to severe weather events, all subsidiaries under the terminal navigation logistics business of the Group conduct emergency plans for severe weather conditions. Extreme weather such as typhoons and flooding may cause serious impacts to the environment and the Group's business operation. The Group has identified several environmental emergencies that exhibit a high likelihood and has correspondingly formulated the Environmental Emergency Response Plan to outline our strategies and procedures for responding to environmental emergencies. The plan outlines the functions and responsibilities of relevant departments in the event of environmental emergencies. Regular drills are conducted to test the adequacy and effectiveness of the plan.

[Section]
Environmental Protection / Employing Electrical Machinery

[Content]
The major contributors to the Group's carbon footprint are fuel consumption of machinery, vehicles, ferries and vessels and electricity consumption from the operation of offices and cargo and passenger terminals. The total amount of GHG emissions was 71,394.34 tCO 2 e, Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions were approximately 63,356.95 tCO 2 e and 8,037.39 tCO 2 e respectively. Therefore, the Group strives to reduce our fuel and electricity consumption in order to cut down the associated GHG emissions.
